title: Device
description: A managed device in OpenManage Enterprise

Type.description: Device type code. Common values are 1000 for servers, 2000 for chassis, 3000 for storage, and 4000 for network devices.

Identifier.description: Device service tag or serial number

DeviceServiceTag.description: Dell service tag for the device

ChassisServiceTag.description: Service tag of the chassis containing this device

IpAddress.description: Management IP address of the device

ManagedState.description: Device management state. 3000 indicates managed, 5000 indicates monitored.

Status.description: Device health status code. 1000 is normal, 2000 is unknown, 3000 is warning, 4000 is critical, 5000 is informational.

ConnectionState.description: Whether the device is currently reachable

PowerState.description: Power state code. 17 is powered on, 18 is powered off, 20 is power cycling.

LastInventoryTime.description: Timestamp of the last inventory collection

LastStatusTime.description: Timestamp of the last status check
